summary: Completed targeted backend + frontend testing for draft publication, Product Edit publish/save behavior, original-price paste button, and rich-description image URL behavior.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful publish (toast shown and backend/state updated), draft UI state remains: Publish Product button and Draft indicator/chip are still visible.
Typing an https image URL then pressing space does not convert to an inline image node.

Paste-to-image behavior is unreliable/flaky in UI automation runs; multiple runs produced no image node, while one run produced one node. Save/reopen persistence could not be reliably validated via UI because image node creation was inconsistent.

integration_issues.issue: Could not validate in this run because there were zero scraped source items and live external scraping is disallowed for this task.

action_items: Fix ProductDetail publish UI state sync: once publish succeeds, draft-only controls/indicators must disappear without requiring manual refresh/navigation.
Fix Tiptap typed-image URL conversion path (space/enter trigger) so valid https image URLs become image nodes.
Stabilize Tiptap paste-image URL conversion and then verify save/reload image HTML persistence through UI.
Seed a temporary scraped item in a controlled non-external way for deterministic Add->Edit Product Sourcing validation in next run.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend draft/publication contract is working: draft PATCH with active=true is rejected for drafts, dedicated publish endpoint transitions draft->live, and storefront visibility follows active status.
Backend sanitizer contract is working for requested scope: remote http(s) img src is retained, alt/title are retained, and unsafe/relative attributes/scripts are stripped.
Frontend console repeatedly shows Tiptap warning: duplicate extension names ['link']; likely worth resolving because editor behavior around URL handling is already unstable.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 targeted tests passed across the executed suites)
success_rate.frontend: 55% (core login/draft-save/publish API state/original-price paste passed; publish-UI-state and rich-editor URL-image flows failed or were unstable)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary products via API during UI tests; cleaned up at end of each run. No persistent source-item seed was created this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not rely on eBay live scraping for this scope. Backend is green for draft and sanitization behavior. Frontend issues are concentrated in ProductDetail publish-state rendering and Tiptap URL->image UX (typed and paste). Product Sourcing Add->Edit remains unverified due no scraped data available in this environment.
rca of the issue: RCA 1: Publish-state mismatch appears frontend-side because backend state/storefront availability turn live immediately while draft-only UI elements stay visible. Repro: create draft product -> open ProductDetail -> click Publish Product -> observe success toast + backend/storefront live, but draft chip/publish control still rendered. RCA 2: Tiptap typed image URL conversion path likely not firing in keydown handler (or replacement transaction not applied), since repeated typed URL + space keeps image node count at 0. Paste path is inconsistent/flaky across runs. MOCKED: Google OAuth customer callback/sign-in remains configuration-only and unrelated to this scope.
